Visit note | 2025-04-02 04:30 PM | Dr. Mahbuba Rahman, Psychiatry | Patient: Salma Sultana, 46, female. Mrs. Sultana attends for review regarding her worry about sleep and waking up tired, specifically mentioning waking at 3 AM every night and being unable to sleep again. This difficulty began after starting rotating shifts at a factory in Kamrangirchar. She is a photographer by profession. She reports no other major complaints and has no comorbidity.
